Photo 0, 1 and 2 show a Canon-branded body labelled EOS 600D with matching button/dial layout.
Photos show overall body condition but no close-up of screen scratches, grip wear, or lens glass clarity; 'sharp' (image quality) cannot be judged from static shelf photos at all.

Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements against light showing no haze, fungus, or scratches

proof_requests: Video clip of the camera powering on, firing shutter, and autofocus cycling on the 18-55mm lens
Close-up photos of front and rear lens glass under light
Screenshot or display of shutter actuation count
Clear photo confirming exactly which items (bodies, lenses, accessories) are included in this sale
Photo of battery, charger, memory card, box/bag if included
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Canon EOS 600D with kit lens, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown usage, untested function, unverified accessories) pending the listed proofs.
